parsed.headline: Trial electricity from Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant in Bangladesh may reach grid by December

pages.text: The Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant in Pabna, Bangladesh, is entering the final stages of development before beginning electricity generation. Sources at the plant stated that up to 300 megawatts of electricity could be connected to the national grid on a trial basis by the end of December. Controlled nuclear fission inside the reactor had been initially scheduled to begin in September, but the process was delayed after faults were detected during safety valve testing. On September 30, 2026, authorities successfully completed a 16-megapascal safety valve pressure test for the plant's first unit. The test, which began on the night of September 29, 2026, involved checking whether control valves functioned properly, monitoring response speeds, warning signals, and required pressure and temperature. Officials at the plant noted that the test was conducted from both the main and emergency control rooms after fire safety and radiation-related safety measures were checked. Another test at a higher pressure of 18 megapascals is expected to be conducted soon. Two plant officials told Prothom Alo that these tests are crucial for commissioning the first unit, as safety valves maintain safe conditions by releasing excessive pressure within the reactor's primary systems. Shafiqul Islam, a professor in the Department of Nuclear Engineering at the University of Dhaka, noted that the megapascal is a unit of pressure.

parsed.headline: Israeli forces shell southern Syria and conduct ground incursions in Quneitra and Daraa provinces

pages.text: According to reports by the Syrian state news agency SANA, Israeli forces shelled areas in southern Syria and carried out a ground incursion into a village in Quneitra province on October 3, 2026. During the incursion in Saida Al-Hanout, an Israeli military patrol reportedly opened heavy fire toward residential buildings and fired directly at media crews, including a SANA reporting team. SANA stated the fire toward journalists appeared to be an attempt to prevent documentation of the incursion. No casualties were reported in the village, though residents reported panic as gunfire continued. In the western Daraa countryside, SANA reported that several artillery shells landed on the outskirts of Abidin in the Yarmouk Basin area while Israeli reconnaissance aircraft flew overhead. No casualties were immediately reported from that incident. These events followed a series of earlier incursions in the region. On September 30, 2026, Israeli armored vehicles entered the villages of Bariqa and Al-Hamidiyah, according to SANA. On October 1, 2026, Israeli forces conducted an overnight incursion into Maariya village in western Daraa. SANA reported that approximately 12 Israeli military vehicles entered the village via a northern road to search homes and detain two residents; one individual was later released, while the whereabouts of the second remained unknown.
